title: Leome and Partners media panel
description: A full-bleed photo panel, at least the window's height (3:2 on wide screens), with two small corner squares near the top, a scrim darkening the lower half and content at the bottom-left; the photo drifts about 8% against the scroll.
notes: the scrim fades to the card colour, so text over it should be light on dark themes
parallax is CSS scroll-driven; without support the photo stands still
empty media shows a muted placeholder
name: leome-and-partners-media-panel

props.name: media
props.description:
A photo or video filling the panel; give it `className="size-full object-cover"`. It sits
in a layer 20% taller than the panel that drifts with the scroll. A placeholder when empty.

props.name: children
props.description: what sits at the bottom of the panel, over the dark scrim (a statement, a heading and a link…)

props.name: marks
props.description: show the two small corner squares near the top
